subject: Logic
title: Appeal to Popularity
description: A short lesson to help you apply Appeal to Popularity.

hook.text: "Fifty million fans can't be wrong!" Actually, yes they can. Popularity proves nothing.

buildup.text: Ad populum says something is true because many people believe it. Numbers replace evidence.

discovery.text: For centuries, most humans believed the Earth was flat. Popularity didn't make it true.

twist.text: Marketers exploit this daily. "Best-selling" implies quality, but sales measure popularity, not truth.

climax.text: A million believers sharing a wrong idea doesn't create a single fact.

quiz.question: What does the appeal to popularity assume?
